Hi! I'm Abhilashini.

I like the contrast of structured mess . It's the sweet spot between order and chaos. It's also where systems sit between the universal and the specific. My work and curiosities keep me at this overlap, building things that survive change and grow with it.

This site distills the agnostic line of inquiry I follow. I primarily explore systems in parts and as a whole, weaving in things that pique my interest. The long-form content has playbooks, write-ups, and projects I learn from. There's also a mosaic of thoughts I collect along the way
